TC-01/S17.title: OK on a look-alike list removes exactly that card, the toast names it, its chart URL is dead, the neighbour survives
TC-01/S17.detail: Nursing Home: n2's card has a trash control (T5) → {"trash":0} | Hospital: the delete confirm is an in-app pop-up, not a native browser dialog (T5) → {"type":"confirm","message":"Remove QA DS1-identity Hosp Ben Rivera from the rounding list?\n\nThis will delete all notes, vitals, and encounter data for this patient."} | Hospital: a message says "QA DS1-identity Hosp Ben Rivera's patient card was deleted" (T6, case-insensitive per Q7) → {"toastText":null}
